title: silene uniflora subsp. prostrata
intro: Silene uniflora subsp. prostrata, commonly known as Alpine Catchfly, is a low-growing, prostrate variety of Silene uniflora, a plant species native to the mountainous regions of Europe. The Alpine Catchfly has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote health and well-being, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the body, particularly in the treatment of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Silene uniflora subsp. prostrata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
